This page provides a detailed week-by-week schedule for STAT 579. Readings should be completed *before* the first class of the week.

- **HR:** Hernán, M. A., & Robins, J. M. (2024). *Causal Inference: What If*.
- **Neal:** Neal, B. (2020). *Introduction to Causal Inference*.
- **Cunningham:** Cunningham, S. (2021). *Causal Inference: The Mixtape*.
- **VanderWeele:** VanderWeele, T. J. (2015). *Explanation in Causal Inference*.

### Part I: Foundations of Causal Inference

| Week  | Dates      | Core Topic                                                                          | Primary Readings                   | Optional Reading (Cunningham)  | Project Connection                          |
| :---- | :--------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------- | :----------------------------- | :------------------------------------------ |
| **1** | Aug 19, 21 | [What is a Causal Effect?](lectures/week-01_what_is_causal_effect.qmd)               | **HR:** Ch. 1–2; **Neal:** Ch. 1–2 | Ch. 2: Potential Outcomes      | Define your causal question.                |
| **2** | Aug 26, 28 | [DAGs & Assumption Transparency](lectures/week-02_DAG.qmd)                           | **Neal:** Ch. 3; **HR:** Ch. 6     | Ch. 3: Directed Acyclic Graphs | Draw a preliminary DAG.                     |
| **3** | Sep 2, 4   | [Exchangeability, Positivity](lectures/week-03_exchangeability_positivity.qmd)      | **HR:** Ch. 7; **Neal:** Ch. 4     | Ch. 4: Regression              | Identify assumptions for your causal model. |
| **4** | Sep 9, 11  | [Bias (Confounding, Selection)](lectures/week-04_bias_seleclection_measurement.qmd) | **HR:** Ch. 8–9                    | \-                             | Consider biases in your dataset.            |
